g.text: Association between force and target light response
Per-recording Spearman correlation | Aligned reference force vs mean positive ΔV
54 manual press recordings | 7,154 eligible frames | Each cell shows ρ and its frame count n
Positive: larger light response tends to accompany larger force. Negative: the opposite tendency.
No extra lag was selected. Force targets retain the original fold-specific alignment.
Descriptive association only; temporal correlation and different force histories limit interpretation.
